review_notes: I read the whole file and the related definitions in the BalancedTransport directory: closedEnlargement in Work.lean, affinePath and lowerEndpoint in TimeRegularity.lean, SpatiallySupported and RepeatsAfter in FieldBounds.lean, and BoundedMixed in Model.lean. The file's own definitions are loadingSwitch, loadingCenter, loadingVelocity, loadingPath and loadingSupport. loadingSwitch is built on Mathlib's Real.smoothTransition. loadingCenter is a scaled difference of vectors. loadingVelocity and loadingPath specialise the project's movingBoxVelocity and affinePath. loadingSupport specialises closedEnlargement, which is Set.Icc with endpoints shifted by η. I found no independent competing version of a Mathlib concept in this file. The file's local notions (JointSmooth, closedEnlargement, affinePath) live in other files, and they are thin named wrappers or project-specific constructions. Those wrappers could in principle be written with Mathlib operations, but the rubric excludes that. I did not search Mathlib for a general-purpose equivalent of the project's moving-box velocity field. I judged the case for consolidation unclear and abstained.
